blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 5, 6, 8 and 11; Milestone 2 T4 and Milestone 3 T6; FINAL-F007 verification contract
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Every non-user replan, including historical entries, must resolve only an exact code-appropriate host-produced Sol or Hermes artifact bound to its contemporaneous run, plan, request, base, candidate and freshness identities; fabricated or internally rehashed substitutions must be rejected without Astra invocation.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: lib/hermes_factory_v2.py:7023-7059 derives acceptable historical Hermes identities from the final state's source_head_before and completed_commits. It accepts any known commit whose recomputed completed prefix matches attacker-rewritten evidence; it does not authenticate the identity recorded when the trigger was reserved. The independent probe changed the genuine trigger from base 3fc98c7f80ecb0b331c528c0553c2dbd8eb6985d/task T1/prefix [T1] to later base 9f30026e6c68e526f78fcc960cced67f99a9c4c1/task T2/prefix [T1,T2], retained candidate_id=null, rehashed the evidence and history record, and updated the history entry. status() accepted the run as complete with zero new Astra calls.
blocking_findings.observed_state: A fabricated historical Hermes transition is authoritative when its substituted base is any real later completed commit and its task/completed/blocked fields are rewritten to the corresponding derivable prefix, even though that identity was not contemporaneous with the trigger.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Historical validation must authenticate the exact base, candidate including null, task, and completed-state identity captured at trigger reservation, so no alternative member of the eventual completed lineage can be substituted by rehashing mutable evidence and history references.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: The strategy transition remains unbound to the transition that actually authorized it. Terminal validation can therefore preserve a fabricated historical replan while reporting COMPLETE, violating durable provenance and fail-closed resume/status correctness.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Persist a content-addressed contemporaneous transition snapshot or equivalent non-reconstructible host lineage at replan reservation, bind the Hermes evidence/history record to its digest, and validate the exact base, candidate including required null, task, completed prefix, plan, and request against that snapshot. Add base substitution to another real completed commit with matching rewritten task/completed/blocked fields through execute, resume, and status; each must reject with zero new Astra or Luna calls.
